programme.title: Food Paradise: Food On Fire
programme.desc: From a chili pepper-topped pizza in Atlanta, to European-style porchetta flame-roasted on a food truck in San Francisco, Food Paradise goes coast to coast on the hunt for sweat-inducing fiery food.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: "Chopped" judge Alex Guarnaschelli teams up with "Chopped Sweets" judge Elizabeth Chambers to give Bobby Flay some bittersweet memories they recruit chefs Leanne Mascoli and Melanie Moss, who are sweet on walking away with a win.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay: Peas of Mind
programme.desc: Lela Loren, star of Power, pairs up with Bobby Flay's pal Michael Symon to try to get Bobby to power down in his own kitchen chefs Lien Lin and Hamidullah Noori attempt to throw Bobby a curveball with a dish he's never heard of.

programme.title: Midnight Misadventures With Mallika Dua
programme.desc: Actress and dancer Sanya Malhotra and Shalishka take on the chopstick challenge and make Punjabi pie.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: Andrew highlights the culinary scene of Glasgow, Scotland, which is just as diverse as the city's landscape from macaroni pies to venison haggis, the whimsical curiosity of the people is reflected in the iconic dishes.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: Andrew explores the charismatic city of Cork, Ireland, where fertile land and an expansive coastline make it a food lovers' haven locals line up for traditional favorites and artisanal delicacies like Irish stew and drisheen.

programme.title: Chopped: A Chopped Halloween
programme.desc: Halloween-themed ingredients including real blood and fake eyeballs are featured in the first round the competitors get dead serious about their Halloween entrées.

programme.title: Last Call Food Brawl: Memphis: Ribs and Nachos
programme.desc: Adam Gertler features four of the best early morning cooks in Memphis, who will square off against each other in an epic battle the challenge is insane nachos and Memphis BBQ.

programme.title: Unique Sweets
programme.desc: From an ice cream shop to a pop-up bake sale, we found the best hangouts in Austin, Texas, to satisfy the sweet tooth.

programme.title: Unique Sweets
programme.desc: Full service cereal bar and bakery cookie art handcrafted sweets experimental ice creams.

programme.title: Food Paradise: Brain Freeze
programme.desc: From seriously seismic shakes in Hawaii to super-size sundaes in New Orleans, Food Paradise gets a taste of the sweet life with some of the coolest frozen treats around.
